# 🚀 Release Checklist

- [ ] Confirm the release commit and source tag.
- [ ] Review merged changes and changelog.
- [ ] Run strict compilation and make test.
- [ ] Run documentation and SVG validation.
- [ ] Review CodeQL and security findings.
- [ ] Confirm README examples and supported platforms.
- [ ] Build artifact from the exact tagged source.
- [ ] Inspect artifact name, platform, and provenance.
- [ ] Record known limitations and skipped checks.
- [ ] Publish release notes only after evidence is available.
- [ ] Preserve previous release references for rollback.
